canonical_project: Quantum Switch Tamasuk DMM-B data center / SPARK expansion
notes: Project-finance coverage said the second QST data center was also located at SPARK, with 9 MW capacity and expected commercial operation in July 2023. DatacenterMap and Reboot Monkey list DMM-B as an operational carrier-neutral QST facility in the Dammam/Khobar market. Mapped locality is the broader Dammam market, but the project source places it at SPARK near Abqaiq/Buqayq.
